description: Add or change a screen in the Greenhouse universal client (apps/client: Expo web, iOS, Android, macOS shell): choose place vs sheet/inspector vs centered dialog (DIALOG_SIZES), build it from the DESIGN.md kit, wire routes under apps/client/app with .web/.ios/.android siblings, call the API through ApiResult helpers with identity-bound writes, add en+zh copy, cover it with React-free unit tests and tests/client-e2e, run the client checks. Covers core screens, Admin sections and official plugin glue. Use for: add a page / screen / dialog / Admin section / plugin native page, 加个页面, 新增界面, 做个弹窗, 加个管理页, 加个后台页面, 客户端页面, 移动端页面. Red lines: never import @greenhouse/*, no raw hex or font sizes, objects open only through openObject.
